About ltc.tx.taxi

ltc.tx.taxi is the Litecoin explorer in the tx.taxi multi-chain family. It preserves Mempool's proven interface for inspecting blocks, transactions, addresses, mining activity, fee estimates, and the live Litecoin mempool while using a Litecoin-specific tx.taxi identity.

Litecoin-native data

Values are denominated in LTC, litoshis, or the selected fiat currency. Fee rates remain lit/vB, transaction sizes remain vB or weight units, and all block, address, and mining concepts shown by the interface retain their Litecoin meaning.

MWEB coverage

This explorer shows transparent-chain transactions and indexed addresses. Private MWEB amounts and recipient history are not publicly observable. HogEx transactions connect the extension block to the transparent chain.

Infrastructure

The explorer reads public Litecoin network data through its configured backend. Explorer results are informational and can differ from another node's view of the mempool. Always verify payment details in your wallet and use your own node when independent verification matters.

Built on open source

This explorer builds on the Mempool Open Source Project. See third-party attribution and contact the maintainer for source and license information.

Privacy Policy

Updated: September 20, 2026


Use Your Own Node When Privacy Matters

ltc.tx.taxi displays public Litecoin chain and mempool data through the backend configured by the site operator. For independent verification and the strongest network privacy, use your own Litecoin node and explorer.


Request Data

Normal website and API requests can reveal standard web metadata to the operator, including your IP address, user agent, requested URL, and request time. Server logs may be retained for reliability, abuse prevention, and debugging.


Local Preferences

Display preferences such as theme, denomination, fiat currency, language, and timezone may be stored in your browser. ltc.tx.taxi does not require an account for ordinary explorer use.


Public Blockchain Data

Litecoin transactions, addresses, scripts, and blocks are public. Looking up an address or transaction can associate that lookup with your network metadata. Do not treat a public explorer as a privacy boundary.


External Links

This site links to tx.taxi contact channels, Litecoin documentation, and upstream source code. Those external services have their own privacy policies.


Open Source Attribution

Mempool names, logos, and trademarks remain the property of their respective owners; ltc.tx.taxi is not affiliated with or endorsed by Mempool Holdings S.A. de C.V.

pages.html:
Litecoin basics

What does this explorer show?

ltc.tx.taxi shows publicly observable Litecoin blocks, transparent transactions and addresses, node mempool data, fees, and mining activity. Litecoin targets a block every 2.5 minutes, retargets difficulty every 2,016 blocks, and halves the subsidy every 840,000 blocks.

How are Litecoin amounts and fees shown?

One LTC equals 100,000,000 litoshis. This explorer reports transaction fees in litoshis and fee rates in lit/vB. A higher fee rate can make a pending transaction more competitive for inclusion, but does not guarantee a confirmation time.

MWEB and privacy

Why are some MWEB details unavailable?

MWEB is Litecoin’s MimbleWimble Extension Block. Its private transfers do not publish ordinary amounts, recipient history, or address balances for an explorer to reconstruct. The HogEx transaction and peg-in or peg-out records connect MWEB to the transparent chain; they should not be read as ordinary wallet transfers.

Data and confirmation

Why can pending data or a fee estimate change?

There is no global mempool. Nodes can observe different pending transactions, and a node can evict or later receive a transaction. Fee estimates and projected blocks are observations of this explorer’s current feed. Check the freshness indicator and headers before relying on a response.

What can I search?

Search a Litecoin block height, block hash, transaction ID, transparent Litecoin address, or a supported explorer URL. A 64-character hash can be valid on more than one chain, so tx.taxi keeps chain selection available when a match is ambiguous.

# Litecoin explorer guide

Canonical: https://ltc.tx.taxi/docs/faq

## Litecoin basics

### What does this explorer show?

ltc.tx.taxi shows publicly observable Litecoin blocks, transparent transactions and addresses, node mempool data, fees, and mining activity. Litecoin targets a block every 2.5 minutes, retargets difficulty every 2,016 blocks, and halves the subsidy every 840,000 blocks.

### How are Litecoin amounts and fees shown?

One LTC equals 100,000,000 litoshis. This explorer reports transaction fees in litoshis and fee rates in `lit/vB`. A higher fee rate can make a pending transaction more competitive for inclusion, but does not guarantee a confirmation time.

## MWEB and privacy

### Why are some MWEB details unavailable?

MWEB is Litecoin’s MimbleWimble Extension Block. Its private transfers do not publish ordinary amounts, recipient history, or address balances for an explorer to reconstruct. The HogEx transaction and peg-in or peg-out records connect MWEB to the transparent chain; they should not be read as ordinary wallet transfers.

## Data and confirmation

### Why can pending data or a fee estimate change?

There is no global mempool. Nodes can observe different pending transactions, and a node can evict or later receive a transaction. Fee estimates and projected blocks are observations of this explorer’s current feed. Check the freshness indicator and headers before relying on a response.

### What can I search?

Search a Litecoin block height, block hash, transaction ID, transparent Litecoin address, or a supported explorer URL. A 64-character hash can be valid on more than one chain, so tx.taxi keeps chain selection available when a match is ambiguous.

pages.description: Read-only REST API documentation for ltc.tx.taxi: blocks, transactions, addresses and supported observations.
pages.html:
Chain

GET Tip Height

GET /api/blocks/tip/height

Returns the current Litecoin tip height as plain text.

curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/blocks/tip/height

Example response

2840000

GET Recent Blocks

GET /api/blocks

Returns the most recently observed blocks. This is served from the shared feed while it is fresh; otherwise the gateway uses its read-only REST source.

curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/blocks

Example response

[{ "id": "block hash", "height": 2840000, "timestamp": 0, "tx_count": 0 }]

GET Block

GET /api/block/:hash

Returns an observed block by its 64-character hash. Use /block-height/:height first when starting with a height.
curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/block/:hash

Example response

{ "id": "block hash", "height": 2840000, "tx_count": 0 }

GET Block Hash by Height

GET /api/block-height/:height

Returns the canonical block hash for a height as plain text.

curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/block-height/:height

Example response

block hash

GET Block Transactions

GET /api/block/:hash/txs

Returns the transparent transactions in a block. MWEB transfer details are not exposed as ordinary address history.

curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/block/:hash/txs

Example response

[{ "txid": "transaction id", "status": { "confirmed": true } }]

Transactions and addresses

GET Transaction

GET /api/tx/:txid

Returns a transparent transaction by ID. Pending status can change; clients should treat it as a snapshot.

curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/tx/:txid

Example response

{ "txid": "transaction id", "fee": 0, "status": { "confirmed": false } }

GET Transaction Status

GET /api/tx/:txid/status

Returns the current confirmation state for a transaction.

curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/tx/:txid/status

Example response

{ "confirmed": true, "block_height": 2840000 }

GET Address

GET /api/address/:address

Returns aggregate transparent-chain statistics for a valid Litecoin address. It cannot reveal MWEB balances, recipients, or private transfer amounts.

curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/address/:address

Example response

{ "address": "ltc1…", "chain_stats": { "tx_count": 0 } }

GET Address Transactions

GET /api/address/:address/txs

Returns the first page of transparent transactions for an address. Continue confirmed history with /address/:address/txs/chain/:last-confirmed-txid.
curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/address/:address/txs

Example response

[{ "txid": "transaction id", "status": { "confirmed": true } }]

Mempool and observed history

GET Mempool Summary

GET /api/mempool

Returns the gateway’s current upstream mempool summary. It describes one node’s view, not a network-wide queue.

curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/mempool

Example response

{ "count": 0, "vsize": 0, "total_fee": 0 }

GET Fee Estimates

GET /api/v1/fees/recommended

Returns fee estimates in lit/vB. Estimates are observations, not confirmation guarantees.
curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/v1/fees/recommended

Example response

{ "fastestFee": 1, "halfHourFee": 1, "hourFee": 1, "economyFee": 1, "minimumFee": 1 }

GET Observed Coverage

GET /api/local-statistics/coverage

Returns only locally retained observation coverage and sample counts. It does not claim archival or complete mining history.

curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/local-statistics/coverage

Example response

{ "historicalCoverage": "observed-only", "coverage": { "sampleCounts": { "blocks": 0 } } }

GET Observed Series

GET /api/local-statistics/series

Returns bounded, locally observed samples for the available mempool, block, and native feed measurements.

curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/local-statistics/series

Example response

{ "mempool": [], "blocks": [], "native": [] }

Service behavior

GET Provider Health

GET /api/provider-health

Returns gateway freshness and health metadata. This endpoint may probe the current mempool summary before reporting an idle state.

curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/provider-health

Example response

{ "stale": false, "feed": { "state": "live" } }

### GET Transaction Status

`GET /api/tx/:txid/status`

Returns the current confirmation state for a transaction.

```
curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/tx/:txid/status
```

Example response

```
{ "confirmed": true, "block_height": 2840000 }
```

### GET Address

`GET /api/address/:address`

Returns aggregate transparent-chain statistics for a valid Litecoin address. It cannot reveal MWEB balances, recipients, or private transfer amounts.

```
curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/address/:address
```

Example response

```
{ "address": "ltc1…", "chain_stats": { "tx_count": 0 } }
```

### GET Address Transactions

`GET /api/address/:address/txs`

Returns the first page of transparent transactions for an address. Continue confirmed history with `/address/:address/txs/chain/:last-confirmed-txid`.

```
curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/address/:address/txs
```

Example response

```
[{ "txid": "transaction id", "status": { "confirmed": true } }]
```

## Mempool and observed history

### GET Mempool Summary

`GET /api/mempool`

Returns the gateway’s current upstream mempool summary. It describes one node’s view, not a network-wide queue.

```
curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/mempool
```

Example response

```
{ "count": 0, "vsize": 0, "total_fee": 0 }
```

### GET Fee Estimates

`GET /api/v1/fees/recommended`

Returns fee estimates in `lit/vB`. Estimates are observations, not confirmation guarantees.

```
curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/v1/fees/recommended
```

Example response

```
{ "fastestFee": 1, "halfHourFee": 1, "hourFee": 1, "economyFee": 1, "minimumFee": 1 }
```

### GET Observed Coverage

`GET /api/local-statistics/coverage`

Returns only locally retained observation coverage and sample counts. It does not claim archival or complete mining history.

```
curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/local-statistics/coverage
```

Example response

```
{ "historicalCoverage": "observed-only", "coverage": { "sampleCounts": { "blocks": 0 } } }
```

### GET Observed Series

`GET /api/local-statistics/series`

Returns bounded, locally observed samples for the available mempool, block, and native feed measurements.

```
curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/local-statistics/series
```

Example response

```
{ "mempool": [], "blocks": [], "native": [] }
```

## Service behavior

### GET Provider Health

`GET /api/provider-health`

Returns gateway freshness and health metadata. This endpoint may probe the current mempool summary before reporting an idle state.

```
curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/provider-health
```

Example response

```
{ "stale": false, "feed": { "state": "live" } }
```

pages.markdown:
# Litecoin WebSocket API

Canonical: https://ltc.tx.taxi/docs/api/websocket

WebSocket endpoint: `wss://ltc.tx.taxi/api/v1/ws`

## Connection

### Initial snapshot

Connect to `/api/v1/ws`, then send `{ "action": "init" }`. The server returns the current shared snapshot when one is available, followed by a `provider-freshness` object.

```
{ "action": "init" }
```

## Shared streams

### Subscribe to shared data

Send `action: "want"` for shared dashboard data. Available shared keys include `blocks`, `mempool-blocks`, `stats`, and `live-2h-chart`. The gateway fans out one upstream dashboard feed; it does not promise per-visitor feeds.

```
{ "action": "want", "data": ["blocks", "mempool-blocks", "stats", "live-2h-chart"] }
```

### Track a transaction or address

A transaction or address can be tracked through the native upstream subscription protocol. Detail feeds are shared by identical subscriptions and capped at eight across this gateway. When capacity is unavailable, the server sends `tracking-unavailable`.

```
{ "track-tx": "transaction id", "watch-mempool": true }

{ "track-address": "ltc1…" }
```

### Interpret freshness

`provider-freshness` is `live`, `stale`, or `unavailable`. A cached snapshot may be delivered during an outage, but is always marked stale rather than presented as current.

```
{ "provider-freshness": { "state": "live", "observedAt": 0 } }
```

## About ltc.tx.taxi

    ltc.tx.taxi is the Litecoin explorer in the tx.taxi multi-chain family. It preserves Mempool's proven interface for inspecting blocks, transactions, addresses, mining activity, fee estimates, and the live Litecoin mempool while using a Litecoin-specific tx.taxi identity.

## Litecoin-native data

    Values are denominated in LTC, litoshis, or the selected fiat currency. Fee rates remain lit/vB, transaction sizes remain vB or weight units, and all block, address, and mining concepts shown by the interface retain their Litecoin meaning.

## MWEB coverage

This explorer shows transparent-chain transactions and indexed addresses. Private MWEB amounts and recipient history are not publicly observable. HogEx transactions connect the extension block to the transparent chain.

## Infrastructure

    The explorer reads public Litecoin network data through its configured backend. Explorer results are informational and can differ from another node's view of the mempool. Always verify payment details in your wallet and use your own node when independent verification matters.

## Built on open source

        This explorer builds on the [Mempool Open Source Project](https://github.com/mempool/mempool). See [third-party attribution](https://ltc.tx.taxi/3rdpartylicenses.txt) and contact the maintainer for source and license information.

# Litecoin explorer guide

Canonical: https://ltc.tx.taxi/docs/faq

## Litecoin basics

### What does this explorer show?

ltc.tx.taxi shows publicly observable Litecoin blocks, transparent transactions and addresses, node mempool data, fees, and mining activity. Litecoin targets a block every 2.5 minutes, retargets difficulty every 2,016 blocks, and halves the subsidy every 840,000 blocks.

### How are Litecoin amounts and fees shown?

One LTC equals 100,000,000 litoshis. This explorer reports transaction fees in litoshis and fee rates in `lit/vB`. A higher fee rate can make a pending transaction more competitive for inclusion, but does not guarantee a confirmation time.

## MWEB and privacy

### Why are some MWEB details unavailable?

MWEB is Litecoin’s MimbleWimble Extension Block. Its private transfers do not publish ordinary amounts, recipient history, or address balances for an explorer to reconstruct. The HogEx transaction and peg-in or peg-out records connect MWEB to the transparent chain; they should not be read as ordinary wallet transfers.

## Data and confirmation

### Why can pending data or a fee estimate change?

There is no global mempool. Nodes can observe different pending transactions, and a node can evict or later receive a transaction. Fee estimates and projected blocks are observations of this explorer’s current feed. Check the freshness indicator and headers before relying on a response.

### What can I search?

Search a Litecoin block height, block hash, transaction ID, transparent Litecoin address, or a supported explorer URL. A 64-character hash can be valid on more than one chain, so tx.taxi keeps chain selection available when a match is ambiguous.

# Litecoin REST API

Canonical: https://ltc.tx.taxi/docs/api/rest

## Chain

### GET Tip Height

`GET /api/blocks/tip/height`

Returns the current Litecoin tip height as plain text.

```
curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/blocks/tip/height
```

Example response

```
2840000
```

### GET Recent Blocks

`GET /api/blocks`

Returns the most recently observed blocks. This is served from the shared feed while it is fresh; otherwise the gateway uses its read-only REST source.

```
curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/blocks
```

Example response

```
[{ "id": "block hash", "height": 2840000, "timestamp": 0, "tx_count": 0 }]
```

### GET Block

`GET /api/block/:hash`

Returns an observed block by its 64-character hash. Use `/block-height/:height` first when starting with a height.

```
curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/block/:hash
```

Example response

```
{ "id": "block hash", "height": 2840000, "tx_count": 0 }
```

### GET Block Hash by Height

`GET /api/block-height/:height`

Returns the canonical block hash for a height as plain text.

```
curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/block-height/:height
```

Example response

```
block hash
```

### GET Block Transactions

`GET /api/block/:hash/txs`

Returns the transparent transactions in a block. MWEB transfer details are not exposed as ordinary address history.

```
curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/block/:hash/txs
```

Example response

```
[{ "txid": "transaction id", "status": { "confirmed": true } }]
```

## Transactions and addresses

### GET Transaction

`GET /api/tx/:txid`

Returns a transparent transaction by ID. Pending status can change; clients should treat it as a snapshot.

```
curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/tx/:txid
```

Example response

```
{ "txid": "transaction id", "fee": 0, "status": { "confirmed": false } }
```

### GET Transaction Status

`GET /api/tx/:txid/status`

Returns the current confirmation state for a transaction.

```
curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/tx/:txid/status
```

Example response

```
{ "confirmed": true, "block_height": 2840000 }
```

### GET Address

`GET /api/address/:address`

Returns aggregate transparent-chain statistics for a valid Litecoin address. It cannot reveal MWEB balances, recipients, or private transfer amounts.

```
curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/address/:address
```

Example response

```
{ "address": "ltc1…", "chain_stats": { "tx_count": 0 } }
```

### GET Address Transactions

`GET /api/address/:address/txs`

Returns the first page of transparent transactions for an address. Continue confirmed history with `/address/:address/txs/chain/:last-confirmed-txid`.

```
curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/address/:address/txs
```

Example response

```
[{ "txid": "transaction id", "status": { "confirmed": true } }]
```

## Mempool and observed history

### GET Mempool Summary

`GET /api/mempool`

Returns the gateway’s current upstream mempool summary. It describes one node’s view, not a network-wide queue.

```
curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/mempool
```

Example response

```
{ "count": 0, "vsize": 0, "total_fee": 0 }
```

### GET Fee Estimates

`GET /api/v1/fees/recommended`

Returns fee estimates in `lit/vB`. Estimates are observations, not confirmation guarantees.

```
curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/v1/fees/recommended
```

Example response

```
{ "fastestFee": 1, "halfHourFee": 1, "hourFee": 1, "economyFee": 1, "minimumFee": 1 }
```

### GET Observed Coverage

`GET /api/local-statistics/coverage`

Returns only locally retained observation coverage and sample counts. It does not claim archival or complete mining history.

```
curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/local-statistics/coverage
```

Example response

```
{ "historicalCoverage": "observed-only", "coverage": { "sampleCounts": { "blocks": 0 } } }
```

### GET Observed Series

`GET /api/local-statistics/series`

Returns bounded, locally observed samples for the available mempool, block, and native feed measurements.

```
curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/local-statistics/series
```

Example response

```
{ "mempool": [], "blocks": [], "native": [] }
```

## Service behavior

### GET Provider Health

`GET /api/provider-health`

Returns gateway freshness and health metadata. This endpoint may probe the current mempool summary before reporting an idle state.

```
curl https://ltc.tx.taxi/api/provider-health
```

Example response

```
{ "stale": false, "feed": { "state": "live" } }
```

# Litecoin WebSocket API

Canonical: https://ltc.tx.taxi/docs/api/websocket

WebSocket endpoint: `wss://ltc.tx.taxi/api/v1/ws`

## Connection

### Initial snapshot

Connect to `/api/v1/ws`, then send `{ "action": "init" }`. The server returns the current shared snapshot when one is available, followed by a `provider-freshness` object.

```
{ "action": "init" }
```

## Shared streams

### Subscribe to shared data

Send `action: "want"` for shared dashboard data. Available shared keys include `blocks`, `mempool-blocks`, `stats`, and `live-2h-chart`. The gateway fans out one upstream dashboard feed; it does not promise per-visitor feeds.

```
{ "action": "want", "data": ["blocks", "mempool-blocks", "stats", "live-2h-chart"] }
```

### Track a transaction or address

A transaction or address can be tracked through the native upstream subscription protocol. Detail feeds are shared by identical subscriptions and capped at eight across this gateway. When capacity is unavailable, the server sends `tracking-unavailable`.

```
{ "track-tx": "transaction id", "watch-mempool": true }

{ "track-address": "ltc1…" }
```

### Interpret freshness

`provider-freshness` is `live`, `stale`, or `unavailable`. A cached snapshot may be delivered during an outage, but is always marked stale rather than presented as current.

```
{ "provider-freshness": { "state": "live", "observedAt": 0 } }
```
